WITH eccs AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg(esi) > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg(esi) BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg(esi) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS avg_scanning_suitability
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT 
            (
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN -5 AND 40 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN -10 AND -5 OR se.ambictemp BETWEEN 40 AND 50 THEN 75
                        ELSE 50
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 30 OR se.humepct BETWEEN 70 AND 80 THEN 75
                        ELSE 50
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.illumelux > 10000 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.illumelux BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 75
                        ELSE 50
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.geosignal = 'Excellent' THEN 100
                        WHEN se.geosignal = 'Good' THEN 75
                        WHEN se.geosignal = 'Poor' THEN 50
                        ELSE 25
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.trackstatus = 'Fixed' THEN 100
                        WHEN se.trackstatus = 'None' THEN 50
                        ELSE 25
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.linkstatus = 'Connected' THEN 100
                        WHEN se.linkstatus = 'Disconnected' THEN 50
                        ELSE 25
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.photomap = '90%' THEN 100
                        WHEN se.photomap = '80%' THEN 80
                        WHEN se.photomap = '60%' THEN 60
                        ELSE 40
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.imgcount > 500 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.imgcount BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN 75
                        WHEN se.imgcount BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN 50
                        ELSE 25
                    END
                )
            ) AS esi
        FROM 
            scanenvironment
        WHERE 
            se.airregistry = scanenvironment.airregistry
    )
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
) 
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS location_id,
    s.zonelabel AS location_name,
    eccs.avg_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    eccs ON s.zoneregistry = eccs.zoneref;

The report is based on the Environmental Condition Classification System (ECCS), which is a comprehensive classification system for archaeological site environments based on their suitability for scanning operations.

The ECCS is a four-tier classification where:
- 'Optimal Scanning Conditions' have ESI > 85
- 'Good Scanning Conditions' have ESI between 70-85
- 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions' have ESI between 50-70
- 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' have ESI  50

The ESI (Environmental Suitability Index) is calculated based on various environmental factors such as ambient temperature, humidity,

events.sql:
WITH eccs AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg(esi) > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg(esi) BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg(esi) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS avg_scanning_suitability
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT 
            (
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN -5 AND 40 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN -10 AND -5 OR se.ambictemp BETWEEN 40 AND 50 THEN 75
                        ELSE 50
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 30 OR se.humepct BETWEEN 70 AND 80 THEN 75
                        ELSE 50
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.illumelux > 10000 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.illumelux BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 75
                        ELSE 50
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.geosignal = 'Excellent' THEN 100
                        WHEN se.geosignal = 'Good' THEN 75
                        WHEN se.geosignal = 'Poor' THEN 50
                        ELSE 25
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.trackstatus = 'Fixed' THEN 100
                        WHEN se.trackstatus = 'None' THEN 50
                        ELSE 25
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.linkstatus = 'Connected' THEN 100
                        WHEN se.linkstatus = 'Disconnected' THEN 50
                        ELSE 25
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.photomap = '90%' THEN 100
                        WHEN se.photomap = '80%' THEN 80
                        WHEN se.photomap = '60%' THEN 60
                        ELSE 40
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.imgcount > 500 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.imgcount BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN 75
                        WHEN se.imgcount BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN 50
                        ELSE 25
                    END
                )
            ) AS esi
        FROM 
            scanenvironment
        WHERE 
            se.airregistry = scanenvironment.airregistry
    )
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
) 
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS location_id,
    s.zonelabel AS location_name,
    eccs.avg_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    eccs ON s.zoneregistry = eccs.zoneref;

        CASE

        END AS avg_scanning_suitability

        scanenvironment se,

                        CASE

                            ELSE 50
                        END
                    ) +

                            WHEN se.illumelux > 10000 THEN 100

                            ELSE 50
                        END
                    ) +
